name: Verdant
long_description:
Verdant prepares local governments for the agentic era. Agents will interact with local governments at volumes and speeds that legacy software and workflows can't handle. Verdant builds both the system of record for agents and internal agents that let local government workflows keep up. 

We're starting with permitting, the highest-volume workflow in local government that requires judgement.
one_liner: AI infrastructure for local government, starting with permitting
